ticker.title: Ticker symbol
ticker.description: Stock ticker (e.g. "AAPL") to get insider filings for one company. Leave blank to scan the market-wide feed of the newest Form 4 filings across all companies.

transactionType.title: Transaction type
transactionType.description: Filter to shares acquired (buys), disposed (sells), or all transactions.

minTransactionValue.title: Minimum transaction value (USD)
minTransactionValue.description: Only return transactions worth at least this much (shares x price). Leave blank for no minimum.

maxFilings.title: Max filings to scan
maxFilings.description: How many recent Form 4 filings to fetch and parse. Each filing can contain multiple transactions.
